title: Definition
text: $$\sin(100\pi)$$ is the y-coordinate of the point on the circle that lies on the positive horizontal axis

title: Coordinate
text: The y-coordinate of the point on the unit circle with angle $$100\pi$$ is $$0$$.\n##figure2.gif##

figureAlts.figure2.gif: Diagram of the coordinate (cosine of 100 pi, sine of 100 pi) on the unit circle, indicating that 100 pi is multiple revolutions all the way around the unit circle.
